god-dev.description: Subagent form of the god-dev skill — opt-in only. By default invoke the god-dev skill inline with the Skill tool so the user watches the implementation. Use this subagent only when the user explicitly asks for a subagent, a parallel fan-out, or a headless run. Picks a mode (small / normal / deep), designs the architecture first in deep mode, removes before it adds, syncs git, loads repo profile + lessons, plans with a shared risk list, self-scores 1–5, hands to god-qa, learns a lesson per finding, closes with a formatted summary and a flowchart doc. Work is not done until god-qa has returned PASS.
